title: All 15 scenarios passed — epoch-safe scene persistence changes verified
summary: This CI run tested the merged PR #172 'feat(scene): epoch-safe semantic map persistence keyed by save tokens' on commit c02f920. All 15 scenarios passed (15/15, 100%), including builtin file operations, camera/lidar snapshots, explore smoke tests, mapping save, memory roundtrip, speech, voiceprint, and flow scenarios for fault recovery, object navigation, and patrol observe. The test also exercised a map save/load/delete cycle with scene object persistence, confirming the new epoch-safe snapshot mechanism works correctly.
pr_changes: system/scene/README.md: Documented epoch-safe Save/Load/Delete map library, SCENE_RESTORE_ON_START legacy mode, and lifecycle watcher epoch response.
system/scene/scene_service/annotations.py: Added has_saved() method to guard against overwriting previously saved room annotations.
system/scene/scene_service/map_binding.py: Updated docstring to reflect lifecycle watcher's epoch response (flush derived objects, flag stale annotations).
system/scene/scene_service/map_meta.py: New file — epoch sidecar (MapMetaStore) pairing each saved map with its object snapshot partition.
system/scene/scene_service/persistence.py: Added partition-scoped persist/load_all, purge_live_partitions, and strict mode for Load path.
system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/builder.py: Object persistence only in legacy SCENE_RESTORE_ON_START mode; default mode passes None.

system/scene/scene_service/service.py: Major refactor — lifecycle watcher now flushes objects on epoch bump, shared ops_lock, semantic_hold for Save blocking, live_binding dict, and SCENE_RESTORE_ON_START logic.
system/scene/scene_service/state/object_registry.py: Added clear_objects() method for lifecycle flush.
system/scene/scene_service/web.py: Map facade (Save/Load/Delete) with epoch-safe snapshot partitions, sidecar commit ordering, and hazard guards (409/502).
system/scene/tests/test_lifecycle_flush.py: New file — state-machine tests for lifecycle watcher epoch response.
system/scene/tests/test_map_epoch.py: New file — epoch-safety tests for web map facade (Save/Load/Delete).
system/scene/tests/test_map_meta.py: New file — unit tests for MapMetaStore sidecar.
test_result: Webots CI exercised 15 scenarios across builtin, cap, and flow families. All passed. Key observations: explore tasks timed out as expected (5.0s/8.0s ceilings); scene graph LLM enrichment repeatedly failed with JSONDecodeError (fake-vlm returns empty response); map save/load/delete cycle with scene object persistence passed all 16 checks (save ok, spatial ok, preview, artifact, load restores 27 objects, delete cleans up).

suggested_fix: No fix needed — all tests passed. Monitor the fake-vlm JSONDecodeError in scene graph LLM enrichment; it is expected with the fake-vlm stub but may indicate a real issue if a production VLM is used.
risks_or_watchouts: Scene graph LLM enrichment repeatedly fails with JSONDecodeError from fake-vlm (returns empty response). This is expected in CI with the fake-vlm stub, but should be monitored when using a real VLM.
Explore tasks time out as expected (5.0s/8.0s ceilings) — no action needed.
Voiceprint list returns 'db not initialised' — expected in CI without a voiceprint database.
The new epoch-safe persistence mechanism introduces complexity in Save/Load/Delete ordering; ensure the ops_lock and semantic_hold guards are tested in production scenarios.
